description: Cracked all the way through, with nothing in the cracks. What reached the bottom of this one was never its own.
lore: A soulstone is the bottom of a creature: one fact, one appetite, pressed to mineral. This one comes out of [[monsters/masked_shadow_creature|Grinmask]] cracked all the way through, and there is nothing in the cracks. Not damage — they all come out like that. The trade's working explanation is short and unpleasant: that shape was emptied long before anyone broke it, so what settled to the bottom of it was never the creature's own. It was the visitor's.

By that reading, everyone who carries one is carrying a fragment of [[lore/the_hole_under_the_mountain|the thing under the mountain]]. Several people have pointed this out. Nobody has stopped. The exception is [[characters/8c41be1e|Hearn]], who has been nearer the source than anyone: he sold his the same evening it was paid to him, under its price, to a buyer he did not look at.
gm_notes: The v1 hook kept at half length: the cave is already in the players' pouches. B6/B7 stay hinted — the visitor is never named, the explanation stays 'working'. Hearn's sale is the only statement he has ever made about the inside, and he did not make it out loud.
